classes.Factory: A factory partition used as a logical data boundary.
classes.Machine: An industrial machine from the Azure predictive-maintenance dataset.
classes.MachineModel: A model category recorded in the machine inventory.
classes.Component: A component name observed in maintenance or failure records.
classes.ErrorCode: An error code recorded by the source system.
classes.ErrorOccurrence: An observed error event with its source timestamp and error code.
classes.MaintenanceEvent: An observed maintenance record for a machine and component.
classes.FailureEvent: An observed failure record from the source dataset.
classes.TelemetryDailySummary: A per-machine, per-day aggregate of measured telemetry.

hasMachine.description: Factory membership in this local graph.

belongsToFactory.description: Factory assignment copied from Phase 1 metadata.

hasErrorOccurrence.description: Observed error event; not a causal assertion.

hasErrorCode.description: Code recorded for an error occurrence.

targetsComponent.description: Component named in the maintenance record.

failureOfComponent.description: Component label recorded for the failure.

hasDailyTelemetry.description: Daily telemetry summary for the machine.

data_properties.machineID: Identifier from the source machine inventory.
data_properties.modelName: Machine model category as recorded by the source.
data_properties.machineAge: Machine age value from the source inventory.
data_properties.errorCode: Error identifier from the source event record.
data_properties.componentName: Component label from the source event record.
data_properties.dailyDate: Calendar date represented by a telemetry aggregate.
data_properties.nSamples: Number of raw telemetry rows in the daily aggregate.
data_properties.voltMean: Daily mean of the source telemetry field volt.
data_properties.voltStd: Daily std of the source telemetry field volt.
data_properties.voltMin: Daily min of the source telemetry field volt.
data_properties.voltMax: Daily max of the source telemetry field volt.
data_properties.rotateMean: Daily mean of the source telemetry field rotate.
data_properties.rotateStd: Daily std of the source telemetry field rotate.
data_properties.rotateMin: Daily min of the source telemetry field rotate.
data_properties.rotateMax: Daily max of the source telemetry field rotate.
data_properties.pressureMean: Daily mean of the source telemetry field pressure.
data_properties.pressureStd: Daily std of the source telemetry field pressure.
data_properties.pressureMin: Daily min of the source telemetry field pressure.
data_properties.pressureMax: Daily max of the source telemetry field pressure.
data_properties.vibrationMean: Daily mean of the source telemetry field vibration.
data_properties.vibrationStd: Daily std of the source telemetry field vibration.
data_properties.vibrationMin: Daily min of the source telemetry field vibration.
data_properties.vibrationMax: Daily max of the source telemetry field vibration.

causal_assertions: Not defined. Co-occurrence in these logs must not be described as proven causation.
temporal_rule: For an explanation at time T, retrieve event and telemetry facts with timestamps <= T only.
